notes.title: Kiss the Demiurge is out now!
notes.content:
We just released Kiss the Demiurge on Steam! 
We're releasing it with a 20% discount. If you like dark comedy, yuri, and psychological themes, check it out!

notes.title: Kiss the Demiurge Demo
notes.content:
Today we released a free demo for Kiss the Demiurge. It's roughly 18,000 words long so it should give you a good idea of how the visual novel will read. 
In the demo you'll see Minori meet the members of the magic club, and her somewhat misguided attempts to gain their trust as she plots the club's downfall. 
We hope you all enjoy the demo!
